# Overview

Restructured to follow the same joint-Bayesian analytical pipeline as
scripts 5v5 (maternal rank) and 7v6 (maternal investment), replacing the
previous lm() + bootstrap + mclapply approach with a joint multivariate
brm() model, compiled once and update()'d per network draw. As in those
scripts, this is run as TWO sequential full-run pipelines - one per
mother-network-position predictor (mom_groom_eigen, mom_prox_eigen) -
each looping over a shared mediator_specs list, with its own sem_data,
TEST chunk, and FULL RUN chunk with PARTIAL saves, combined into a
single final output at the end.

Predictor = mother's own eigenvector centrality in her proximity and
grooming networks (Beta-Binomial posteriors, extraction logic unchanged
from the previous version of this script). Mediator = son's own raw
social network metrics - the same 6 mediators used in scripts 5v5/7v6
(prox_strength, prox_degree, groom_out_strength, groom_in_strength,
groom_out_degree, groom_in_degree), NOT the PC1/PC2 composite scores
used in the earlier version of this script. REQUIRES prox_posteriors.rds
and groom_posteriors.rds to already exist.

THREE FIXES APPLIED (matching scripts 5v5/7v6's validated corrections,
plus one specific to this script):

  1. The previous version used weights = obs_weight inside lm(), which
     is a FREQUENCY-type weight (as if an observation with weight 0.25
     contributes a quarter of a full observation), not a
     measurement-precision downweighting. FIXED: sigma ~ obs_weight
     (heteroscedastic/distributional regression) is now used in BOTH
     equations of the joint brms model instead.

  2. The previous version fit mediator and outcome equations as two
     SEPARATE lm() calls per bootstrap replicate, which does not yield
     a genuine joint posterior over (a, b, c'). FIXED: both equations
     are now fit as ONE joint multivariate brms model (bf_mediator +
     bf_outcome), so a, b, c' are drawn together, properly paired, from
     the same MCMC draws each network-draw iteration.

  3. Uncertainty was previously represented via a nonparametric
     bootstrap (n_boot = 500 resamples) nested inside each of 1,000
     network draws (500,000 total lm() fits per predictor-mediator
     pair). FIXED: the bootstrap is dropped entirely - posterior
     uncertainty now comes directly from the joint brms model's own
     MCMC draws, combined across network draws, exactly as in scripts
     5v5/7v6. This also removes the need for mclapply parallelization
     inside the mediation function (the compile-once-then-update()
     pattern is itself the runtime-saving device here).

Residual correlation (set_rescor) is NOT included - consistent with
scripts 5v5/7v6, where it was tested and found not well identified at
comparable sample sizes.

Convergence must be checked via summarise_draws(as_draws_df(fit)), NOT
posterior::ess_bulk(as_draws_array(fit)) - the latter returned spurious
NA/near-zero values during validation testing in script 5v5.

Note: unlike scripts 5v5/7v6, BOTH the predictor (mother's eigenvector
centrality) and the mediator (son's network metric) are posterior-derived
here, so build_draw_data() draws both from their respective posterior
lists on each iteration k, rather than only the mediator.

Outcome column is elo_one_year_male_male, matching scripts 5v5/7v6
(changed from elo_one_year_all used in the earlier version of this
script).

# Compute observation weight (used as a sigma predictor)

```{r compute-weight}
emigrants_full <- emigrants_full %>%
  mutate(
    start_date_effective = if_else(!is.na(DateImmigration1),
                                    as.Date(DateImmigration1),
                                    as.Date(DepartureNatalGp)),
    window_end = start_date_effective + 365,
    effective_end = if_else(!is.na(LastSeen1) & LastSeen1 < window_end,
                             LastSeen1, window_end),
    days_present_first_year = pmin(as.numeric(effective_end - start_date_effective), 365),
    obs_weight = days_present_first_year / 365
  )
```

# 1. Extract mother's eigenvector centrality (Beta-Binomial posteriors)

```{r eigen-metrics-function}
compute_eigen_from_posterior <- function(dyadic_data, all_nodes, focal_node,
                                          num_draws = 1000,
                                          prior_a = 0.1, prior_b = 0.1,
                                          edge_thresh = 0.0001) {

  n_dyads <- nrow(dyadic_data)
  n_nodes <- length(all_nodes)

  draw_mat <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_dyads, ncol = num_draws)
  for (d in 1:n_dyads) {
    draw_mat[d, ] <- rbeta(num_draws,
                            prior_a + dyadic_data$event[d],
                            prior_b + dyadic_data$duration[d] - dyadic_data$event[d])
  }

  node1 <- as.character(dyadic_data$node_1)
  node2 <- as.character(dyadic_data$node_2)

  eigen_draws <- numeric(num_draws)

  for (k in 1:num_draws) {
    adj <- matrix(0, n_nodes, n_nodes, dimnames = list(all_nodes, all_nodes))
    for (r in 1:n_dyads) {
      w <- draw_mat[r, k]
      if (w < edge_thresh) w <- 0
      adj[node1[r], node2[r]] <- w
      adj[node2[r], node1[r]] <- w
    }
    g <- igraph::graph_from_adjacency_matrix(adj, mode = "undirected", weighted = TRUE)
    ec <- tryCatch(igraph::eigen_centrality(g, weights = igraph::E(g)$weight)$vector,
                    error = function(e) setNames(rep(NA, n_nodes), all_nodes))
    eigen_draws[k] <- ec[focal_node]
  }

  eigen_draws
}
```

```{r mother-window-helper}
get_mother_windows <- function(sons_data) {
  sons_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(Momcode), !is.na(DOB), !is.na(juvenile_period_end), !is.na(BirthGp)) %>%
    distinct(Momcode, BirthGp, DOB, juvenile_period_end)
}
```

```{r mother-grooming-eigen-extraction}
extract_mother_grooming_eigen <- function(grooming_data, mother_windows, num_draws = 1000) {

  results <- list()
  posterior_draws <- list()

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(mother_windows))) {

    mom_code   <- mother_windows$Momcode[i]
    group_name <- mother_windows$BirthGp[i]
    win_start  <- mother_windows$DOB[i]
    win_end <- mother_windows$juvenile_period_end[i]

    window_groom <- grooming_data %>%
      filter(group_Abbreviation == group_name, date >= win_start, date <= win_end)

    if (nrow(window_groom) == 0) next

    indiv_days <- window_groom %>%
      tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(idindividual1, idindividual2), values_to = "individual") %>%
      group_by(individual) %>%
      summarise(days_observed = n_distinct(date), .groups = "drop")

    dyadic_data <- window_groom %>%
      filter(idindividual1 != "", idindividual2 != "", !is.na(idindividual1), !is.na(idindividual2)) %>%
      mutate(node_1 = pmin(idindividual1, idindividual2), node_2 = pmax(idindividual1, idindividual2)) %>%
      filter(node_1 != node_2) %>%
      group_by(node_1, node_2) %>%
      summarise(event = n_distinct(date), .groups = "drop") %>%
      left_join(indiv_days, by = c("node_1" = "individual")) %>% rename(days_1 = days_observed) %>%
      left_join(indiv_days, by = c("node_2" = "individual")) %>% rename(days_2 = days_observed) %>%
      mutate(duration = days_1 + days_2 - event)

    if (nrow(dyadic_data) == 0 || !mom_code %in% c(dyadic_data$node_1, dyadic_data$node_2)) next

    all_nodes <- unique(c(dyadic_data$node_1, dyadic_data$node_2))

    tryCatch({
      eigen_draws <- compute_eigen_from_posterior(dyadic_data, all_nodes, mom_code, num_draws)

      key <- paste(mom_code, group_name, win_start, sep = "_")
      posterior_draws[[key]] <- list(mom_groom_eigen = eigen_draws)

      results[[i]] <- tibble(Momcode = mom_code, BirthGp = group_name, DOB = win_start,
                              mom_groom_eigen_mean = mean(eigen_draws, na.rm = TRUE),
                              n_dyads_mom_groom = nrow(dyadic_data))

      message("Done (grooming eigen): mother ", mom_code)
    }, error = function(e) message("Error (grooming) for mother ", mom_code, ": ", e$message))
  }

  list(summaries = bind_rows(results), posteriors = posterior_draws)
}
```

```{r mother-proximity-eigen-extraction}
extract_mother_proximity_eigen <- function(scans, mother_windows, num_draws = 1000) {

  results <- list()
  posterior_draws <- list()

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(mother_windows))) {

    mom_code   <- mother_windows$Momcode[i]
    group_name <- mother_windows$BirthGp[i]
    win_start  <- mother_windows$DOB[i]
    win_end <- mother_windows$juvenile_period_end[i]

    scans_filtered <- scans %>%
      mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
      filter(group_Abbreviation == group_name, date >= win_start, date <= win_end)

    if (nrow(scans_filtered) == 0) next

    proximity_data <- extract_proximity_pairs(scans_filtered)
    if (is.null(proximity_data) || nrow(proximity_data) == 0) next

    individual_scan_counts <- bind_rows(
      scans_filtered %>% filter(!is.na(idindividual1), idindividual1 != "") %>%
        distinct(idindividual1, scan_id) %>% rename(individual = idindividual1),
      proximity_data %>% filter(!is.na(interaction_partner), interaction_partner != "") %>%
        distinct(interaction_partner, scan_id) %>% rename(individual = interaction_partner)
    ) %>% distinct() %>% group_by(individual) %>%
      summarise(scans_sampled = n_distinct(scan_id), .groups = "drop")

    dyadic_data <- proximity_data %>%
      filter(!is.na(idindividual1), idindividual1 != "", !is.na(interaction_partner), interaction_partner != "") %>%
      mutate(node_1 = pmin(idindividual1, interaction_partner), node_2 = pmax(idindividual1, interaction_partner)) %>%
      filter(node_1 != node_2) %>%
      group_by(node_1, node_2) %>%
      summarise(event = n_distinct(scan_id), .groups = "drop") %>%
      left_join(individual_scan_counts, by = c("node_1" = "individual")) %>% rename(scans_node_1 = scans_sampled) %>%
      left_join(individual_scan_counts, by = c("node_2" = "individual")) %>% rename(scans_node_2 = scans_sampled) %>%
      mutate(duration = scans_node_1 + scans_node_2 - event)

    if (nrow(dyadic_data) == 0 || !mom_code %in% c(dyadic_data$node_1, dyadic_data$node_2)) next

    all_nodes <- unique(c(dyadic_data$node_1, dyadic_data$node_2))

    tryCatch({
      eigen_draws <- compute_eigen_from_posterior(dyadic_data, all_nodes, mom_code, num_draws)

      key <- paste(mom_code, group_name, win_start, sep = "_")
      posterior_draws[[key]] <- list(mom_prox_eigen = eigen_draws)

      results[[i]] <- tibble(Momcode = mom_code, BirthGp = group_name, DOB = win_start,
                              mom_prox_eigen_mean = mean(eigen_draws, na.rm = TRUE),
                              n_dyads_mom_prox = nrow(dyadic_data))

      message("Done (proximity eigen): mother ", mom_code)
    }, error = function(e) message("Error (proximity) for mother ", mom_code, ": ", e$message))
  }

  list(summaries = bind_rows(results), posteriors = posterior_draws)
}
```

# 2. Build sem_data (one per predictor, mirrors mom_key matching)

Both predictors are keyed to mother-windows (Momcode + birth-group +
DOB), not directly to Code, so each son is matched to his mother's
eigen-centrality posterior via the mom_key prefix-match used in the
original script. This is done once per predictor here (matching scripts
5v5/7v6's pattern of building sem_data before the mediation function),
rather than inside the mediation function on every call.

```{r build-sem-data-function}
build_predictor_sem_data <- function(emigrants_full, predictor_posteriors) {
  emigrants_full %>%
    mutate(mom_key_prefix = paste0(Momcode, "_")) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(mom_key = {
      matches <- names(predictor_posteriors)[startsWith(names(predictor_posteriors), mom_key_prefix)]
      if (length(matches) == 0) NA_character_ else matches[1]
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(!is.na(mom_key), !is.na(elo_one_year_male_male), !is.na(obs_weight))
}
```

```{r build-sem-data}
sem_data_mom_groom_eigen <- build_predictor_sem_data(emigrants_full, mother_groom_eigen_posteriors)
sem_data_mom_prox_eigen  <- build_predictor_sem_data(emigrants_full, mother_prox_eigen_posteriors)
```

# 4. Summary helper

```{r summarize-network-draws-function}
summarize_network_draws <- function(estimates) {
  tibble(
    estimate_mean   = mean(estimates),
    estimate_median = median(estimates),
    network_q025    = quantile(estimates, 0.025, names = FALSE),
    network_q975    = quantile(estimates, 0.975, names = FALSE),
    prop_positive   = mean(estimates > 0),
    prop_negative   = mean(estimates < 0)
  )
}
```

# 5. Convergence check helper (uses the VALIDATED reliable method)

```{r convergence-check-function}
check_joint_convergence <- function(fit, rhat_threshold = 1.01, ess_threshold = 400) {
  summ <- summarise_draws(as_draws_df(fit))
  bad_rhat <- summ %>% filter(rhat > rhat_threshold)
  bad_ess  <- summ %>% filter(ess_bulk < ess_threshold | ess_tail < ess_threshold)

  ok <- nrow(bad_rhat) == 0 && nrow(bad_ess) == 0

  if (!ok) {
    cat("    CONVERGENCE WARNING:\n")
    if (nrow(bad_rhat) > 0) {
      cat("    Parameters with Rhat >", rhat_threshold, ":\n")
      print(bad_rhat %>% select(variable, rhat))
    }
    if (nrow(bad_ess) > 0) {
      cat("    Parameters with ESS <", ess_threshold, ":\n")
      print(bad_ess %>% select(variable, ess_bulk, ess_tail))
    }
  }

  list(ok = ok, max_rhat = max(summ$rhat, na.rm = TRUE),
       min_ess = min(c(summ$ess_bulk, summ$ess_tail), na.rm = TRUE))
}
```

# 6. Joint Bayesian mediation function (compile once, update() per draw)

Same internal logic as scripts 5v5/7v6's mediation function, generalized
only in that BOTH predictor_raw and mediator_raw are re-drawn from their
respective posterior lists on every iteration k (since both mother's
eigen-centrality and son's PC score are posterior-derived here, unlike
scripts 5v5/7v6 where only the mediator varied by draw).

```{r joint-bayesian-mediation-function}
run_mother_eigen_mediation_bayesian_joint <- function(sem_data, predictor_posteriors, predictor_field, predictor_label,
                                                        spec, num_draws, chains = 2, iter = 2000, warmup = 1000,
                                                        adapt_delta = 0.95) {

  cat("Running JOINT BAYESIAN mediation:", predictor_label, "->", spec$name, "\n")

  males_with_mediator <- sem_data$Code[sem_data$Code %in% names(spec$posteriors)]
  dat <- sem_data %>% filter(Code %in% males_with_mediator)

  if (nrow(dat) < 10) {
    cat("  Too few males with posteriors:", nrow(dat), "— skipping\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  cat("  Males with all data:", nrow(dat), "\n")

  first_predictor_post <- predictor_posteriors[[dat$mom_key[1]]][[predictor_field]]
  first_mediator_post  <- spec$posteriors[[dat$Code[1]]][[spec$field]]
  actual_draws <- min(length(first_predictor_post), length(first_mediator_post))
  num_draws <- min(num_draws, actual_draws)

  predictor_point_estimates <- sapply(dat$mom_key, function(key) {
    mean(predictor_posteriors[[key]][[predictor_field]][1:num_draws], na.rm = TRUE)
  })
  predictor_center <- mean(predictor_point_estimates, na.rm = TRUE)
  predictor_scale   <- sd(predictor_point_estimates, na.rm = TRUE)

  mediator_point_estimates <- sapply(dat$Code, function(id) {
    mean(spec$posteriors[[id]][[spec$field]][1:num_draws])
  })
  mediator_center <- mean(mediator_point_estimates)
  mediator_scale   <- sd(mediator_point_estimates)

  build_draw_data <- function(k) {
    dat_k <- dat
    dat_k$predictor_raw <- sapply(dat_k$mom_key, function(key) predictor_posteriors[[key]][[predictor_field]][k])
    dat_k$mediator_raw  <- sapply(dat_k$Code,    function(id)  spec$posteriors[[id]][[spec$field]][k])
    dat_k$predictor_z   <- (dat_k$predictor_raw - predictor_center) / predictor_scale
    dat_k$mediator_z    <- (dat_k$mediator_raw  - mediator_center)  / mediator_scale
    dat_k$male_elo_z    <- scale(dat_k$elo_one_year_male_male)[, 1]
    dat_k
  }

  dat_1 <- build_draw_data(1)

  # ── Validated joint model structure: heteroscedastic sigma ~ obs_weight
  # in both equations, NO residual correlation (not well identified at
  # comparable n - see script 5v5 for validation testing details) ────────
  bf_mediator <- bf(mediator_z ~ predictor_z, sigma ~ obs_weight)
  bf_outcome  <- bf(male_elo_z ~ mediator_z + predictor_z, sigma ~ obs_weight)

  cat("  Compiling joint Stan model (draw 1)...\n")
  t0 <- Sys.time()

  fit_base <- brm(
    bf_mediator + bf_outcome + set_rescor(FALSE),
    data = dat_1, family = gaussian(),
    chains = chains, iter = iter, warmup = warmup,
    seed = 1, refresh = 0, silent = 2,
    control = list(adapt_delta = adapt_delta)
  )

  compile_time <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))
  cat("  Compilation + first fit took", round(compile_time, 1), "seconds\n")

  # Check convergence on draw 1 before proceeding - if this fails, no
  # point continuing to 1,000 more draws with the same problem
  conv1 <- check_joint_convergence(fit_base)
  if (!conv1$ok) {
    cat("  WARNING: draw 1 did not converge cleanly (max Rhat =",
        round(conv1$max_rhat, 4), ", min ESS =", round(conv1$min_ess, 1), ") - inspect before proceeding\n")
  }

  a_all <- numeric(0); b_all <- numeric(0); c_all <- numeric(0); ind_all <- numeric(0)

  for (k in 1:num_draws) {

    dat_k <- if (k == 1) dat_1 else build_draw_data(k)

    fit_k <- if (k == 1) fit_base else update(fit_base, newdata = dat_k, recompile = FALSE, refresh = 0, silent = 2)

    post_k <- as_draws_df(fit_k)

    a_post   <- post_k$b_mediatorz_predictor_z
    b_post   <- post_k$b_maleeloz_mediator_z
    c_post   <- post_k$b_maleeloz_predictor_z
    ind_post <- a_post * b_post   # genuinely paired within-draw, from one joint posterior

    a_all   <- c(a_all, a_post)
    b_all   <- c(b_all, b_post)
    c_all   <- c(c_all, c_post)
    ind_all <- c(ind_all, ind_post)
  }

  results <- bind_rows(
    summarize_network_draws(a_all)   %>% mutate(path = "a (mom eigen -> son network mediator)"),
    summarize_network_draws(b_all)   %>% mutate(path = "b (son network mediator -> male elo)"),
    summarize_network_draws(c_all)   %>% mutate(path = "c' (mom eigen -> male elo, direct)"),
    summarize_network_draws(ind_all) %>% mutate(path = "indirect (a * b)")
  ) %>%
    mutate(predictor = predictor_label, mediator = spec$name, n = nrow(dat),
           num_draws = num_draws, .before = 1)

  cat("\n  === Joint Bayesian results:", predictor_label, "->", spec$name,
      "(n =", nrow(dat), ",", num_draws, "network draws) ===\n")
  for (j in 1:nrow(results)) {
    cat(sprintf("  %-35s posterior mean = %6.3f  95%% interval [%6.3f, %6.3f]  %4.1f%% pos\n",
                results$path[j], results$estimate_mean[j],
                results$network_q025[j], results$network_q975[j],
                results$prop_positive[j] * 100))
  }
  cat("\n")

  list(
    summary = results,
    pooled_posterior = tibble(a = a_all, b = b_all, c_prime = c_all, indirect = ind_all),
    draw1_convergence = conv1
  )
}
```
